text_block_list.text:
I just suddenly feel like eating...
Ehehe. ☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
But don't worry! I have a feeling this
level of
hunger will help guide me to the
finish line even
faster!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
All right! I'm going to get first place,
then eat a
whooole lot when I get back!

text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono is full of energy and
raring to go!
